data.body:
[INFO][risk:high security review]
Failure modes: non-canonical states, undefined map reads, identity collisions, or expansion beyond declared resource limits.
Edge cases: nested Option, tuple, Set, and Map layouts; empty or singleton forms; duplicate and dynamic keys; post-state reads; wide fan-outs.
Rollback: revert target commit 382a06206cee73824caf8b974babcd8974c8f5f2. The model-core wire format is unchanged.
Monitoring: alert on cml.lower.* refusals, #defined violations, UpdateOutOfDomain, and resource-limit spikes. Preserve these RED outcomes.
Validation: whole-range static tracing covered slot preflight and canonical init (lower.rs:1309-1568), layout bijection (lower/layout.rs:205-332), canonicity and definedness (lower/collections.rs:809-923,1753-1830), action folding (lower.rs:2238-2603), and aggregate bounds (lower.rs:1905-1980,2374-2479). The range includes independent oracle and exact-boundary tests. This metadata-only review did not execute them.
No security blocker found. LGTM does not satisfy any risk:critical human-approval gate.
